body_lead: Maharashtra to install Kerala-like AI cameras to detect traffic violations The Maharashtra government is likely to adopt Kerala's model with AI camera-based traffic enforcement approach. Maharashtra's Transport Commissioner Vivek Bhimanwar paid a visit to Kerala for the same. The Maharashtra government is considering adopting the 'Kerala model' of utilising Artificial Intelligence (AI) cameras to enhance traffic enforcement.
